servo_presets.rollsThePlaneLeftWhenDown: Rolls the plane left when down
servo_presets.rollsThePlaneRightWhenDown: Rolls the plane right when down
servo_presets.pitchesTheNoseUpWhenTrailing: Pitches the nose up when trailing edge goes up
servo_presets.flyingWingCombinesRollAndPitch: Flying wing - combines roll and pitch
servo_presets.tricopterTailServoForYawControl: Tricopter tail servo for yaw control
servo_presets.standardPlaneWithAileronsElevatorRudder: Standard plane with ailerons, elevator, rudder
servo_presets.mostCommonSetupForPlanesSeparate: Most common setup for planes. Separate control surfaces for each axis.
servo_presets.elevonsCombineAileronAndElevatorFunction: Elevons combine aileron and elevator function. No tail surfaces.
servo_presets.vTailSurfacesCombineElevatorAnd: V-tail surfaces combine elevator and rudder. Standard ailerons.
servo_presets.deltaWingWithElevonsAndRudder: Delta wing with elevons and rudder
servo_presets.likeFlyingWingButWithA: Like flying wing but with a vertical tail for rudder.
servo_presets.onlyTheRearYawServoNeeds: Only the rear yaw servo needs configuration. Motors are handled separately.
servo_presets.forCameraStabilizationUsesRcInput: For camera stabilization. Uses RC input, not stabilized output.
